title: fix(grid,dashboard): order select groups and chart categories by declared options (objectui#11809)
body:
Fixes #11809

Clause-②: no

A grid grouped by a select field, and a dashboard chart over a select dimension, now list the values in the field's declared option order: Backlog → To Do → In Progress → In Review → Done, and Low → Medium → High → Urgent. Before, the grid sorted its groups by label, and a dataset chart drew its bars (and a donut its legend) in the order the dataset returned them.

## What changed

- **`plugin-grid`, `useGroupedData.ts`.** Both group sorts (the server's header rows, and the rows a host hands in) now go through one comparator, `compareGroupEntries`. For a field with a declared option order it puts the options in that order, reverses it for `order: 'desc'`, puts any value the options do not declare after them (by label), and puts the empty group last. Empty and undeclared values sit last in both directions. A field with no options keeps label order. A multi-value key ranks as the tuple of its members' positions.
- **`plugin-grid`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`.** The grid holds the object definition, so it builds the per-field ranks from each grouping field's `options` and hands them to the hook. It reads them through `@object-ui/core`'s `buildCategoryOrder` and `buildCategoryRank`, the reading the funnel already uses. The memo is keyed on the order itself (a string), not on `schema.grouping`, which hosts rebuild every render.
- **`plugin-dashboard`, `DatasetWidget.tsx`.** The chart branch charts a copy of the rows ordered by the first dimension's declared option order: declared options first, undeclared values next in the order the dataset returned them, the empty bucket last. When a chart splits one measure by a second select dimension, its series and legend follow that dimension's declared order. `chartRows` itself is not reordered, so it keeps its index alignment with `drillRawRows`, which the drill lookup uses. An explicit `options.sortBy` is the author's order and is left as the dataset returned it. The table and pivot paths are unchanged.

## Signature and published surface

- The published `useGroupedData` keeps its signature byte for byte. It now delegates to `useGroupedDataInOptionOrder`, which takes one more argument, the per-field ranks (`GroupOptionRanks`). Both new names are exported from the module `useGroupedData.ts` so `ObjectGrid` can import them. The package entry (`src/index.tsx`) is unchanged, and `exports` maps only `.` and `./style.css`, so neither name can be reached from the published entry. With no option order to read, the published hook keeps label order. A CONTROL pin holds that.
- `DatasetWidget`'s helper `declaredOptionPosition` is module-private. No prop, type member, export or language-pack key is added in either package.
- `AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` is not changed. See the measurement below for why its existing `categoryOrder` prop was not widened.

## File surface: one file outside the claim

`packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is not on the claim's `File surface:` line. It is needed because `useGroupedData` receives no field metadata, and `ObjectGrid` is where the grid builds its grouping (the dispatch's Zone 2 point 1 anticipated this). The dev reported it before this PR was opened, as the claim requires.

## Measured: which path draws the showcase widgets

Read from objectstack `examples/app-showcase` (`ops-dashboard.dashboard.ts`, `chart-gallery.dataset.ts`) and objectui `origin/main`:

- *Tasks by Status* is `bar_status` (`type: 'bar'`, dataset `showcase_task_metrics`, dimension `status`). *Priority Mix* is `donut_priority` (`type: 'donut'`, same dataset, dimension `priority`). Both `DashboardGridLayout` and `DashboardRenderer` route a dataset-bound widget to `DatasetWidget`. Its chart branch renders `type: 'chart'` through `ChartRenderer` into `AdvancedChartImpl`.
- The order is the dataset's `GROUP BY` order. The stored values sorted alphabetically (`backlog, done, in_progress, in_review, todo` and `high, low, medium, urgent`) give exactly the orders the card reports. Nothing on the client reordered a bar or pie chart. `AdvancedChartImpl`'s only sort is the funnel's. The two sorts the claim cites in `DatasetWidget.tsx` belong to the flat TABLE: the empty-dimension sink and the header-click sort.
- `DatasetWidget` already derived the first dimension's declared order (`categoryOrder`, framework#3588) and passed it to every chart family. `AdvancedChartImpl` applies it only to the funnel. Widening it there was not done for two reasons. It is a published prop (`ChartRendererProps.schema.categoryOrder`, documented for funnel and pyramid). And `DatasetReportRenderer` (plugin-report) passes it for every chart family next to a report's explicit `order`, so the widening would override an author's explicit report order in a package outside this surface. The reorder lives in `DatasetWidget`, where the explicit `sortBy` is in view.
- Kanban (the control): `plugin-kanban` imports neither changed module, and the diff touches no file in it. Its lanes come from `field.options` in order, mapped inline in `ObjectKanban.tsx`; it has no shared helper to reuse. The dashboard's *Task Status* filter lists its own `options`, declared in the dashboard metadata. The reusable reader of a picklist's order is core's `buildCategoryOrder` / `buildCategoryRank`, and both surfaces use it.

## Tests

New pins (run from the repo root; the final run is on HEAD `72c7ae8`):

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/groupSelectOptionOrder-11809.test.tsx`: 9 tests. They drive the real `ObjectGrid` on both the server-grouped path and the client-grouped path. Group by Status, Group by Priority and `desc` are covered, with an undeclared value and an empty group in the data. Two hook-level tests cover the multi-value tuple order, and a CONTROL holds that the published `useGroupedData` keeps label order. Two CONTROLs hold that a text field keeps label order.
- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.selectOptionOrder-11809.test.tsx`: 7 tests on the real `DatasetWidget`, `SchemaRenderer` and dimension-metadata read. They cover the bar by status, the donut by priority, server-resolved labels, pivoted series order, and a drill on a moved bar that opens that bar's records. Two CONTROLs hold that an explicit `sortBy` keeps the dataset's order and that a dimension with no options keeps it too.

Ablation, run on `de2b75e` (the three source files are byte-identical to `72c7ae8`: `git diff --quiet` exits 0). The fix was committed first, and each mutation went through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, which confirms the anchor hit, that the mutation landed, and that the restore brought the file back to the HEAD blob:

- Grid, with `compareGroupEntries` forced to label order: **6 failed, 3 passed**. The 3 that passed are the three CONTROLs. Restore: blob `4090a29e845e` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Chart, with the category rank and the series rank both nulled: **5 failed, 2 passed**. The 2 that passed are the two CONTROLs. Restore: blob `c97b49629905` equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Local gates

Run from the worktree root. Each exit code was read before any pipe. The final head is `72c7ae8`, after merging `origin/main` at `2b30d39`, which touches only `packages/app-shell`, `packages/plugin-view` and two changesets.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/`, on `352bde9`: 187 of 188 files passed, 1735 of 1736 tests. `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`, on `352bde9`: 173 of 174 files passed, 1732 of 1739 tests, 6 skipped. The one red file in each package was an existing pin that relied on the old order. Both are restated in this PR: `gridGroupingMembers-8071` (label order with field options) and `DatasetWidget.optionLabelI18n`'s drill boundary (it clicked the first category). Since `352bde9`, the only changes in either package are those two test files: `git diff --quiet` exits 0 over both packages with the two files excluded.
- On `72c7ae8`: `pnpm exec vitest run` over the two restated pins, the two new pin files, and three `app-shell` suites that render `DatasetWidget` (`DatasetPreview.dimensionLabels-8187`, `DatasetPreview`, `DashboardView.autoRefresh-11062`). 7 of 7 files passed, 52 of 52 tests.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` exit 0 on `72c7ae8`, after `turbo run build` over both packages' dependency closures (14 of 14 tasks). `tsc --listFilesOnly` shows that `tsconfig.test.json` includes both new pin files.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the seven touched files: 0 errors. The two new test files raise no warnings.
- Each of these exits 0 on `72c7ae8`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, and `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (7 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset).
- Not run: the i18n gates (no locale pack changed) and `check:readme-exports` (no entry export changed).

## Acceptance notes

- **Same defect class, outside this surface. Not changed, not filed. Carrier: none named.** `plugin-report`'s `DatasetReportRenderer` charts the dataset's rows in the order they came back, unless the report declares an `order`. `plugin-charts`' `ObjectChart` (the `view:chart` and `object-chart` aggregate path) does not pass a declared order either. Both would show the same alphabetical order over a select dimension. Neither was measured on a public surface in this run.
- The dataset TABLE and PIVOT keep the dataset's row order, by design (objectui#5827, objectui#4263). The card names grouped lists, category axes and legends, not tables.
- The order among undeclared values differs between the two surfaces. The grid sorts them by label, as it sorted every group before. A chart keeps them in the order the dataset returned them, as the funnel does. The card's ruling sets only that they come last.
- NOT MEASURED: the live showcase console in a browser. The pins drive the real `ObjectGrid` and `DatasetWidget` with the showcase's options.

The dev run is session `session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8` (subagent of the seat 3 `domain:ui` PM).
